reviews.title: Best Looking RTX 5090, and performs as good as it looks. Max core O.C at 3200 Mhz.
reviews.comment: Best looking card in the RTX 5090 series. What a clean and crisp, polished finish! Performs really well too. Use it mainly in a dedicated Flight Simulator Setup, along with an Amd Ryzen 9800x3d cpu and 64 gb Gskill DDR5 ram at 6000 mhz cas 30. Overclocking: It overclocks really well, I have set it at a core of +300 and Memory at +3000 Mhz (for an effective 17000 Mhz), power limit at 100 % in MSI afterburner. It runs very stable in MS 2024 with a peak GPU clock of 3195 Mhz, and an average of 3050 Mhz. Geforce drivers v581.42. Temperatures peak around 77C, avg at around 70, with fans at 100%. Perhaps temps are a bit higher than other RTX 5090 with larger coolers, but running a bit hotter does not bother me, my 7900XTX Sapphire Nitro runs hotter at 90C measured at GPU hotspot in a large case with cooling so not a bother for me. Boosting core to +325 Mhz boosts Max OC to over 3200 Mhz but it is not game stable in Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 at extended periods of use (+4 hours), which seems to be very finicky with Graphic Card overclocking. Some people don't like the infinity mirror they feel it reduces cooling. Running in the high 70s at 100% GPU load in a case with good cooling is good enough for me. Very expensive, but I am in love with this card. Definitely worth it if you appreciate and are into high end PC hardware as a (expensive) hobby. I would definitely buy it all over again (I did in fact, like it so much I got another Zotac Solid RTX 5090 version for a dedicated Racing Simulator setup replacing another 7900XTX). The included firestorm software isn't great, I don't use it, MSI Afterburner is a better choice and easier to use. I think Zotac has the arguably best looking cards by far this series. Only negative from the company is Zotac extended 5 year warranty upon registration is not valid in the US, only in Asia and Europe markets.

reviews.title: This is a high-quality, powerful card.
reviews.comment: The card demonstrates high quality and impressive performance, which aligns with the expectations for a 5090 model. Its design is sleek and aesthetically pleasing. The value offered is reasonable, and the accompanying software is user-friendly and visually appealing. The fan noise is minimal, and the size of the card is manageable. It is recommended to use a power supply of at least 1200W, as the card can draw over 1000W when paired with a 14900K processor. Although the RGB cable could be black instead of white, and the included support stand could be slightly taller, these are minor considerations. Overall, this card is an excellent choice.
reviews.author: Docwitty

reviews.title: Large card
reviews.comment: This graphics card looks absolutely awesome, i’ve been eyeing one for months and it was time to get my hands on it! Ordered it up second hand from amazon, the card showed up as described! (Like new) i was so excited to install it, only to realize the card is just a hair too long for my 25L hp omen case, doh! unfortunately, i didn’t think to check dimensions before ordering and falsely assumed it would be the same size as the zotac 3080 ti i was attempting to replace. No fault of the manufacturer at all, just a goof up on my part.
